title: A Hymn for the Visitor
author: Noor Brightwater
blurb: Tamsin Quintana, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
